bio: With its menu of sashimi, tataki, gyozas, uromaki rolls etc, this small Japanese restaurant located just a few metres from the Ramón Sánchez-Pizjuán stadium is gaining an ever-increasing local fanbase. In its attractive dining room, embellished with designer details and a pleasant bar from where the chefs can be observed hard at work (their skill at slicing fish and preparing tempura is particularly impressive), enjoy traditionally inspired Japanese cuisine....
